The petitioners have been allotted a plot of land by the respondent no. 7 society,
measuring 3 Bighas- 3 kathas-10 Lessas covered by Dag No.1071 (Old)/1074(New) of K.P. Patta No.
271 of village- Hengrabari, Mouza- Beltola, which land, they are occupying by constructing dwelling houses thereupon.

sentences.text: 3 The petitioners have approached this Court apprehending that the State would acquire the aforesaid plot of land by denying just compensation to the petitioners, urging that only the Society may be paid compensation by ignoring the claim of the petitioners.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-5 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 19 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: Mr. Biswas submits that the only relief the petitioners are seeking is that they should be served with a prior notice if the State proposes to acquire the aforesaid land.

sentences.text: Mr. P. Nayak, learned Standing Counsel, GAD, Assam, appearing for the respondent nos. 5 and 6 submits that there is no cause of action for filing this writ petition.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-5 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 19 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: Mr. Nayak, however, submits that no process of acquisition would be carried out without following the due process of law.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-5 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 19 October, 2023.json

sentences.text:
The learned departmental counsel has also pointed out that another similar writ petition being WP(C)
7457/2018, filed by the Society, is pending disposal before this Court and is fixed on 08/11/2023.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-5 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 19 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: In view of the above, issue notice of motion returnable on 08/11/2023.

sentences.text:

Nayak, learned Standing Counsel, GAD, Assam, has accepted notice on behalf of the respondent nos.
5 & 6, service of notice is deemed to be complete on the said respondents.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-5 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 19 October, 2023.json

sentences.text: However, extra copies of the writ petition, requisite in numbers, be furnished to the learned departmental counsel within three days from today, so as to enable them to obtain instruction.

sentences.text: Page No.# 5/5 Petitioners to take steps for service of notice upon the respondent no. 7 by registered post with A/D within three days.

sentences.text: Heard on the prayer of interim relief.

sentences.text: In view of the projected dispute between the petitioners and the respondent no. 7 and taking note of the averments made in the writ petition, it is hereby provided that no amount of compensation for acquisition of the land shall be released to either of the parties without the leave of this Court.

sentences.text:
For the purpose of acquiring land for construction of functional and residential building of Katlicherra Sub-Division [Irrigation], different parcels of land from the said villages were acquired vide L.A.
Case no. 13 [IRRI] 85-86, L.A. Case no. 14 [IRRI] 85-86 and L.A. Case no. 15 [IRRI] 85- 86.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-5 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 11 November, 2024.json

sentences.text: From the case papers, more particularly, from Letter no. HLA 24/87/35 dated 02.07.1990 [Annexure-VII], it transpires that after publication of a Notification under Section 4 and a Declaration under Section 6 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 [since repealed], the respondent Irrigation Department had sanctioned a preliminary land accusation estimates, Rs. 2,16,120.58 in connection with the three land accusation cases, referred to above, and placed the fund at the disposal of Deputy Commissioner, Hailakandi.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-5 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 11 November, 2024.json

sentences.text:
Subsequently, the cost of acquiring lands was estimated at Rs. 2,06,625.63 in connection with L.A. Case no. 13 [IRRI] 85-86; Rs. 2,78,154.73 in connection with L.A. Case no. 14 [IRRI] 85-86; and Rs. 3,35,775.52 in connection with L.A. Case no.
15 [IRRI] 85-86; as reflected in the document prepared by the Deputy Commissioner, Hailakandi on 31.07.1998.
sentences._hearing_file: Page No.# 1-5 vs The State Of Assam And 6 Ors on 11 November, 2024.json

sentences.text: The revised estimates of the three cases have been mentioned in the document at pages 44, 46 & 48 of the case papers.

sentences.text: 6. Despite elapse of more than nine years, the respondent authorities have not responded by placing the details as regards publication of the declaration under Section 6 and the Award under Section 11 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 [since repealed].

opennyai_summary.19_October_2023__facts:
The petitioners have been allotted a plot of land by the respondent no. 7 society,
measuring 3 Bighas- 3 kathas-10 Lessas covered by Dag No.1071 (Old)/1074(New) of K.P. Patta No.
271 of village- Hengrabari, Mouza- Beltola, which land, they are occupying by constructing dwelling houses thereupon.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
3 The petitioners have approached this Court apprehending that the State would acquire the aforesaid plot of land by denying just compensation to the petitioners, urging that only the Society may be paid compensation by ignoring the claim of the petitioners.
The learned departmental counsel has also pointed out that another similar writ petition being WP(C)
7457/2018, filed by the Society, is pending disposal before this Court and is fixed on 08/11/2023.
opennyai_summary.19_October_2023__decision:
In view of the above, issue notice of motion returnable on 08/11/2023.
However, extra copies of the writ petition, requisite in numbers, be furnished to the learned departmental counsel within three days from today, so as to enable them to obtain instruction.
In view of the projected dispute between the petitioners and the respondent no. 7 and taking note of the averments made in the writ petition, it is hereby provided that no amount of compensation for acquisition of the land shall be released to either of the parties without the leave of this Court.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
However, predecessor of the answering respondent has written to the Revenue and Disaster Management Department in the year of 1989 vide Letter no. HLA.24/87/27, dated 30.12.1989 for taking necessary action for publication of notification & declaration in Gazette.
6. Despite elapse of more than nine years, the respondent authorities have not responded by placing the details as regards publication of the declaration under Section 6 and the Award under Section 11 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 [since repealed].
